name: Taste LGD #6
description:
Taste is subjective.
Some like pepper,
Some like salt,
Some like sweet,
Some none of the above.
Some like wine,
Some like juice,
Some like garlic,
Some neither of the two,
I like my taste,
Because it’s mine.
Since you like yours,
We’ll get along just fine.
